hypothesis: A gentler, later plateau reduction may refine the three-layer ReLU model under the same 60-epoch budget.
test_policy: Training and original validation only; do not load test images or use test metrics.
comparison_note: Adaptive next candidate after GELU did not beat ReLU. Training and validation only. Augmentation30 compares with ReLU30; gentle60 compares with ReLU60. Same seed2112; no seed checks. Run only if the full cap plus reporting reserve fits the original UTC deadline.
stopping_rule: At most 30 epochs, five non-improving validation macro-F1 epochs, or 300 seconds checked between epochs. Final checkpoint verification and training-fit evaluation can add overhead.
